provenance.instrument: Code of the City of Altoona, Chapter 800 Zoning (adopted 9-8-2025 by Ord. No. 5833), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: Chapter 800 was adopted 9-8-2025 by Ord. No. 5833 and repealed the 2016 zoning chapter. eCode360 includes legislation through 04-13-2026 and lists New Laws (0). eCode360 is Cloudflare-walled for plain fetches. Text was read in a browser from the print view of the whole chapter.
checks: ADUs are permitted (P) only in RN-A and RN-B (800-29 Principal Use Table). Not listed in RN-C, RN-D or the mixed-use, commercial and industrial districts

The ADU must be attached to or inside the house, or attached to or inside an existing accessory structure such as a garage or carriage house. It must share at least one wall or be structurally connected (800-31D, 800-88 definition)

A new free-standing cottage is not allowed. A garage unit needs an existing accessory structure ('an existing accessory structure such as a garage or carriage house'). A garage built new for the unit is excluded

An addition to the house must meet the principal setbacks: RN-A side 10 ft and rear 30 ft, RN-B side 3 ft and rear 25 ft (800-14C(1), 800-15C(1)). The 3 ft and 7 ft accessory setbacks apply only to a unit in an existing accessory structure
No accessory structure may be erected or enlarged in front of the main structure (800-10G(1))

A rented ADU needs a residential rental unit license from the Code Official, with inspection. Applications are due by July 31 each year. A family exemption may be granted for a parent, adult child, grandparent or sibling of the owner (570-1, 570-3)
Max 1,000 sq ft or 80% of the principal structure, whichever is smaller (800-31E)
The lot must meet the district minimum lot size: RN-A 6,000 sq ft, RN-B 2,725 sq ft (800-31B, 800-14, 800-15)
The owner must live in one of the units. The ADU may only be occupied as a principal residence (800-31G, K)
Separate address and mail receptacle for the ADU (800-31J). Same style and materials as the house or garage (800-31I)
Not allowed in cluster developments. No manufactured or movable homes (800-31F, H)
The 800-60 parking table has no ADU row. Single-unit residential needs 1 to 3 spaces per dwelling unit. If the ADU counts as a dwelling unit, the lot needs 2 spaces in total. Ask the zoning office
Conversion of a single-family dwelling existing at the effective date into a multifamily dwelling is a separate use (800-36). It is SE in RN-C, RN-D, MX-N and MX-C per the use table (800-29)

term.note: '§ 800-31. Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU).' 800-31A also says 'accessory apartment (ADU)'.

status.note: 'Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs)' row: P in RN-A and RN-B, subject to 800-31. Owner occupancy required.

path.note: P means permitted use. A zoning permit when 800-31 is met. No hearing.

fallback_path.note: Other districts show no ADU use. A lot that fails 800-31 needs a variance from the Zoning Hearing Board.

zoning_districts.note: ADU row: 'P / P' for RN-A and RN-B, blank for the other eight districts.

building_types.note: 'a lot containing a single-unit or two-unit principal residential structure'. No detached or attached limit.

min_lot_sqft.note: 'located on a lot which meets the requirement for the minimum lot size, as specified in the applicable zoning district'. RN-A 6,000 sq ft, RN-B 2,725 sq ft. See districts.

existing_structure_only.note: 'For the conversion or construction of an ADU'. An addition attached to the house is allowed. A garage unit must use an existing accessory structure.

value.condition: A unit outside the house must be attached to or inside an existing accessory structure such as a garage or carriage house. A new free-standing building, or a garage built for the unit, does not qualify.
An addition to the house meets the principal setbacks: side 10 ft, rear 30 ft (RN-A). Not the 3 ft and 7 ft accessory setbacks.
An addition to the house meets the principal setbacks: side 3 ft, rear 25 ft (RN-B).
RN-B: accessory structures sit 10 ft from the rear of the principal structure (RN-A 8 ft).
No accessory structure may be erected, or enlarged, in front of the main structure.
Same architectural style and materials as the house or existing accessory structure. Separate address and mail receptacle. Permanent foundation, not a manufactured or movable home.
A rented ADU needs a residential rental unit license, with inspection. Applications by July 31 each year. Family exemption for a parent, adult child, grandparent or sibling of the owner.

gates.note: Form, setback, design and rental conditions.

requires_conforming_lot.note: 'the building shall be located on a lot which meets the requirement for the minimum lot size, as specified in the applicable zoning district.'

types_allowed.note: 'attached to or integrated within the existing principal residential structure or an existing accessory structure such as a garage or carriage house.' Reading: over a garage only when the garage exists. No new free-standing unit.

max_sqft.note: 'An ADU shall not exceed 1,000 square feet or 80% of the size of the principal structure, whichever is smaller.'

max_share_of_house.note: 80% of the size of the principal structure.

max_height_ft.note: 'Accessory building/structure [max] 25 ft' in RN-A and RN-B.

setback_front_ft.note: No accessory front setback listed. The principal primary street setback is '20 ft or Average'.

setback_side_ft.note: Accessory structure: 3 ft on lots wider than 25 ft, 18 in on narrower lots.

separation_ft.note: RN-A accessory structure: 'Rear of principal structure 8 ft'. RN-B: 10 ft (800-15C(2)), shown as a gate. A garage ADU must also be structurally connected to that garage.

internal_uses_district_height.note: 'shall comply with all minimum dimensional requirements'. An ADU in the house uses the 35 ft principal height.

max_impervious.note: Lot coverage includes all impervious surfaces: RN-A 50%, RN-B 60%. No single number.

owner_occupancy.note: 'The owner(s) of any lot containing an ADU shall permanently reside in at least one of the dwelling units on the premises.'

family_only.note: No family or age limit in 800-31.

occupancy.value: The owner lives in one of the units. The ADU is occupied only as someone's principal place of residence.

short_term_rental_banned.note: 'An ADU shall only be occupied as a principal place of residence.' Reading: bars short-term rental of the ADU only. The house is not covered by 800-31K.

max_adus.note: 'One attached ADU shall be permitted on a lot'. District density: 'Accessory dwelling unit 1'.

spaces_required.note: No ADU row. 'Single-unit residential / 1 per dwelling unit / 3 per dwelling unit' (minimum and maximum).

reading.value: No ADU row. 'Single-unit residential' needs at least 1 space per dwelling unit (max 3). 1 in total if the ADU does not count as a unit, 2 if it does.

min_lot_sqft.note: RN-A lot area minimum. An ADU lot must meet the district minimum lot size (800-31B). Principal setbacks: side 10 ft, rear 30 ft. Lot coverage max 50% including all impervious surfaces.

setback_front_ft.note: '20 ft or Average', the average of the four nearest lots if less. Applies to the principal structure, which an ADU must be attached to or within.

setback_side_ft.note: Principal structure 'Side setback [min] 10 ft'. Applies to an ADU attached to the house. A detached ADU uses the accessory setbacks in envelope (3 ft side, 7 ft rear).

setback_rear_ft.note: Principal structure 'Rear setback [min] 30 ft'. Accessory structures: rear lot line 7 ft, 8 ft from the rear of the principal structure.

principal_max_height_ft.note: 'Primary building height [max] 2.5/35 ft'. Accessory building 25 ft.

min_lot_sqft.note: RN-B lot area minimum. An ADU lot must meet the district minimum lot size (800-31B). Principal setbacks: side 3 ft, rear 25 ft. Lot coverage max 60% including all impervious surfaces.

setback_front_ft.note: '20 ft or Average', the average of the four nearest lots if less. Applies to the principal structure, which an ADU must be attached to or within.

setback_side_ft.note: Principal structure 'Side setback [min] 3 ft'. Applies to an ADU attached to the house. A detached ADU uses the accessory setbacks in envelope (3 ft side, 7 ft rear).

setback_rear_ft.note: Principal structure 'Rear setback [min] 25 ft'. Accessory structures: rear lot line 7 ft, 10 ft from the rear of the principal structure.

principal_max_height_ft.note: 'Primary building height [max] 2.5/35 ft'. Accessory building 25 ft.
